verdict.rationale: HubSpot publishes a versioned, per-endpoint API reference (e.g., the Get Account Details page) with inline OpenAPI 3.0.1 specs and request examples like `POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts`. That establishes a structured, machine-readable reference, but nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or lets users run calls from the docs. The probe 404s hit root-level paths rather than the documented /docs/llms.txt and per-page specs, so they don't contradict this. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/console in the reference, runnable code samples executable from the docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.
